name: @epoch/procurement-runtime
description: Epoch Procurement Runtime service (W037): the thin typed HOST FACADE over @epoch/procurement — requirement intake (lineage + package assembly over the REAL W036 acquisition requests), quoting through the SupplierPort adapter seam (ONE in-memory reference adapter; the core never names a vendor), selection, W036 commitment linkage, purchase-order issue/amendment (version-chained), supplier-delivery tracking (append-only state machine with accumulating partial receipts linked to W036 observation intake), substitution decisions behind the constraint-evaluation gate, and the derived-only acquisition-status projection. Every step emits procurement:* events (W010-shaped, one package = one stream stream:procurement-<suffix>) sealed by the kernel and pinned by REAL sealEvent parity tests. The W009 authorization gate denies unauthorized intake BEFORE any kernel admission; tenant isolation is typed tenant-isolation-rejected; replayed intake (same content-addressed idempotency key) returns sealed prior records (the typed duplicate-intake-returned admission). In-memory reference behavior: NO persistence, NO network, NO real supplier systems; core logic stays pure (zero wall-clock, zero randomness — instants are caller-supplied).
